_schema.description: Stop conditions for the autonomous master-plan loop. Complements docs/AGENTS.md Done-Definition and long-running-loop rule.

may_stop_only_when.condition: completion ledger has no pending or blocked master-plan items
every complete item has implementation, verification, documentation, critic, and closeout evidence
conditional operational/security/supply-chain evidence exists for relevant surfaces
all credible Linus/principal-engineer critique findings fixed or explicitly rejected with rationale
documentation surfaces (catalog, contracts, ADRs, runbooks) match implementation and no stale forward claims remain
grit status or scaffold-lock ledger shows no unresolved claims owned by this run
ICM completion summary stored and id captured
final report includes claims we can make and claims we cannot make yet
no known errors remain; any unverifiable check is listed as a gap, not as pass

allowed_blocked_exit: Only when no meaningful recovery path remains; final report must use blocked status, not completion status.
purpose: Stop conditions for the autonomous master-plan loop. Complements docs/AGENTS.md Done-Definition and long-running-loop rule.
